name: Date Property Alerts
changes: The Alerts view now shows Snooze 1 hour, Snooze 1 day and Snooze custom without Pro. They show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, and do not snooze until Pro is on.
tip: Embed the base in a daily note and pick its Alerts view. Alerts then run while that note is open.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Date Property Alerts is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep track of your dates.
